evidence_kind: record of actual commands used, added alongside immutable original reports
note: The old harness accepted --physics-profile but did not embed the resolved Physics fields in each row. These commands used the final libccd/8kHz profile. The updated harness embeds it for future runs. R3 is a reset-pose battery on the legacy radius0.75m disc, not the final octagonal arena. Nominal R1 is a commanded-retreat stress course; clearance is not guaranteed.

runs.command: PYTHONPATH=src OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 .venv/bin/python scripts/combat_recovery_impact.py --group R1 --count 160 --seed 29001 --physics-profile configs/combat/physics_octagon.yaml --course trip --no-first-roll --out <fresh-output>
